ex: Can you wait *a few minutes*? The bus is coming.
你可以等幾分鐘嗎？公車快來了。
*Quite a few* students in my class have a cat.
我們班上有相當多同學養貓。
I only have *a little time* before my next class.
下堂課前我只剩一點時間。
Can you speak *a little bit* slower, please?
可以請你說慢一點點嗎？
There are *a lot of* people on the MRT this morning.
今天早上捷運上有很多人。
*Thanks a lot* for helping me with my homework.
非常感謝你幫我寫作業。
I feel *a lot better* after a good night's sleep.
好好睡一覺後，我覺得好很多了。
I get up *at seven a.m.* on school days.
上學日我早上七點起床。

collocs.zh: 從上午九點到下午五點
ex: The library is open *from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.*
圖書館從上午九點開放到下午五點。
I go to swimming class *once a week*.
我一週上一次游泳課。
I spend *half an hour* on the MRT every morning.
我每天早上搭捷運要花半小時。
Everyone *has the ability to* learn a new language.
每個人都有能力學習一種新語言。
She has a *natural ability* to make people laugh.
她天生就有逗人發笑的本事。
I *was able to* finish the test on time.
我能夠準時寫完考試。
My friends and I *talked about* the new teacher at lunch.
我和朋友午餐時聊到新來的老師。
Don't *worry about* the test. You studied hard.
別擔心考試，你已經很用功了。
It takes *about ten minutes* to walk to school.
走路到學校大約要十分鐘。
Yushan is almost 4,000 meters *above sea level*.
玉山海拔將近四千公尺。
Her English score is *above average* this term.
她這學期的英文成績高於平均。
Look at *the example above* before you start.
開始之前先看上面的例子。
My cousin wants to *study abroad* after high school.
我表哥高中畢業後想出國留學。
We usually *travel abroad* during summer vacation.
我們通常在暑假出國旅行。
Have you ever *gone abroad* by yourself?
你曾經自己一個人出國過嗎？
His long *absence from school* worried the teacher.
他長時間缺課，讓老師很擔心。
She came back to the club after *a long absence*.
她離開很久之後，又回到社團了。
Three students *were absent from* class today.
今天有三個同學缺席。
I *accepted the invitation* to her birthday party.
我接受了她生日派對的邀請。
Please *accept my apology* for being late.
我遲到了，請接受我的道歉。
I deleted the photo *by accident*.
我不小心把照片刪掉了。
My uncle *had an accident* on his scooter last week.
我叔叔上週騎機車出了意外。
Nobody was hurt in the *traffic accident*.
那場車禍沒有人受傷。
My parents opened a *bank account* for me.
我爸媽幫我開了一個銀行帳戶。
Students *account for* half of the library's visitors.
學生占了圖書館訪客的一半。
The bakery is *across the street* from our school.
麵包店就在我們學校的對街。
The MRT station is *across from* the park.
捷運站在公園對面。
Be careful when you *walk across* the road.
過馬路時要小心。
We must *act quickly* when there is a fire.
發生火災時，我們必須迅速行動。
My sister will *act in a play* at school.
我妹妹會在學校演一齣戲。
Giving up your seat is *an act of kindness*.
讓座是一種善行。
We need to *take action* to keep our school clean.
我們必須採取行動，保持校園整潔。
My brother loves watching *action movies* on weekends.
我哥哥週末很愛看動作片。
My grandma walks every day to *stay active*.
我奶奶每天走路，讓身體保持活動力。
She *takes an active part in* the school's English club.
她積極參與學校的英文社。
Hiking is one of my favorite *outdoor activities*.
爬山是我最喜歡的戶外活動之一。
We have *club activities* every Friday afternoon.
我們每週五下午有社團活動。
Kids need an hour of *physical activity* every day.
孩子每天需要一小時的體能活動。
He dreams of becoming *a famous actor*.
他夢想成為一位有名的演員。
Who won *Best Actor* at the awards this year?
今年頒獎典禮上誰得到最佳男主角？
My cousin wants to be *a famous actor* someday.
我表弟希望有一天成為有名的演員。
She won *Best Actress* for her first movie.
她以第一部電影拿下最佳女主角。
*A famous actress* visited our school today.
今天有一位有名的女演員來我們學校。
The young star won *Best Actress* last night.
那位年輕的明星昨晚拿下最佳女主角。
*The actual price* was higher than the ad said.
實際價格比廣告上寫的還高。
This picture shows the bug at *actual size*.
這張圖畫的是蟲子的實際大小。
Nobody knows *what actually happened* that night.
沒有人知道那天晚上實際上發生了什麼事。
*Add salt* to the soup at the end.
最後再在湯裡加鹽。
*Add up* all the numbers and write the answer.
把所有數字加起來，寫下答案。
The heavy rain *added to* the traffic problems downtown.
大雨讓市區的交通問題更嚴重。
*In addition*, you need to bring a pencil.
此外，你還需要帶一枝鉛筆。
*In addition to* English, she studies Japanese.
除了英文，她還學日文。
Little kids learn *addition and subtraction* first.
小朋友先學加法和減法。
Please write your *home address* on the form.
請在表格上寫下你的住家地址。
What's your *email address*? I'll send you the notes.
你的電子郵件地址是什麼？我把筆記寄給你。
We stopped to *admire the view* from the mountain.
我們停下來欣賞山上的風景。
I *really admire* people who can speak three languages.
我很欽佩會說三種語言的人。
It takes courage to *admit a mistake*.
承認錯誤需要勇氣。
My sister *was admitted to* a good university.
我姊姊被一所好大學錄取了。
In Taiwan, you *become an adult* at eighteen.
在台灣，滿十八歲就是成年人了。
An *adult ticket* costs twice as much as a child's.
全票的價錢是兒童票的兩倍。
Please buy your train tickets *in advance*.
請事先買好火車票。
*Advances in technology* have changed how we learn.
科技的進步改變了我們學習的方式。
I saw *an advertisement for* a new phone on the MRT.
我在捷運上看到一支新手機的廣告。
Kids see many *TV advertisements* for snacks.
孩子們會看到很多零食的電視廣告。
My grandpa likes to *give advice* to young people.
我爺爺喜歡給年輕人建議。
I *took my teacher's advice* and read every day.
我聽了老師的建議，每天閱讀。
Let me give you *a piece of advice*: sleep early.
讓我給你一個建議：早點睡。
The doctor *advised me to* drink more water.
醫生建議我多喝水。
Teachers *strongly advise* students to review every day.
老師強烈建議學生每天複習。
Our teacher asks us to read about *current affairs*.
老師要我們閱讀時事。
My uncle works in *foreign affairs* for the government.
我叔叔在政府從事外交事務的工作。
Using your phone late at night can *affect your health*.
深夜還在用手機會影響你的健康。
Many flights *were affected by* the typhoon.
很多航班受到颱風影響。
My little brother *is afraid of* the dark.
我弟弟怕黑。
*I'm afraid* I can't come to your party.
恐怕我不能去你的派對。
Don't *be afraid to* ask questions in class.
上課時不要害怕發問。
We play basketball *after school* every day.
我們每天放學後打籃球。
Our English test is *the day after tomorrow*.
我們的英文考試在後天。
He got home, and *soon after*, it started to rain.
他回到家，不久之後就開始下雨了。
I have two classes *in the afternoon*.
我下午有兩堂課。
Are you free *this afternoon* to study together?
你今天下午有空一起讀書嗎？
We have piano lessons *on Saturday afternoon*.
我們星期六下午上鋼琴課。
I listened to the song *again and again*.
我一遍又一遍地聽那首歌。
*Once again*, he forgot his homework.
他又一次忘了帶作業。
Don't give up; you can *try again* tomorrow.
別放棄，你明天可以再試一次。
Using phones in class is *against the rules*.
上課用手機是違反規定的。
My parents *are against* my plan to buy a scooter.
我爸媽反對我買機車的計畫。
Don't *lean against* the doors on the MRT.
在捷運上不要靠著車門。
He started playing the piano *at the age of* five.
他五歲就開始彈鋼琴。
My cousin and I are *the same age*.
我和表弟同年紀。
*A long time ago*, people did not have phones.
很久以前，人們沒有手機。
We moved to Taichung *two years ago*.
我們兩年前搬到台中。
I *agree with* you about the movie.
關於那部電影，我同意你的看法。
My dad *agreed to* take us to the beach.
我爸爸同意帶我們去海邊。
We couldn't *agree on* a name for our team.
我們對隊名一直無法達成共識。
I don't *agree with* everything he says.
我不是完全同意他說的每件事。
The two classes finally *reached an agreement*.
兩個班最後終於達成協議。
Everyone in the group *was in agreement*.
小組裡大家的意見一致。
"Can I use your pen?" "*Go ahead*."
「我可以用你的筆嗎？」「請用。」
There were ten people *ahead of* me in line.
排隊時我前面有十個人。
It's smart to *plan ahead* before exams.
考試前事先規劃是聰明的做法。
We learned *first aid* in health class.
我們在健康課學了急救。
My grandpa wears a *hearing aid* in his left ear.
我爺爺左耳戴著助聽器。
*The aim of* this lesson is to practice speaking.
這堂課的目的是練習口說。
Our school *aims to* help every student read more.
我們學校的目標是幫助每位學生多閱讀。
*Aim at* the center of the target.
瞄準靶的正中央。
Let's open the window and get some *fresh air*.
我們打開窗戶，透透新鮮空氣吧。
*Air pollution* is bad in some cities in winter.
有些城市冬天的空氣汙染很嚴重。
The package will be sent *by air*.
這個包裹會用空運寄出。
It's so hot. Can you *turn on the air conditioner*?
好熱，你可以開冷氣嗎？
Please *turn off the air conditioner* when you leave.
離開時請關冷氣。
Passengers may now *board the aircraft*.
旅客現在可以登機了。
We saw *military aircraft* at the air show.
我們在航空展上看到了軍機。
We flew to Osaka on a *budget airline*.
我們搭廉價航空飛到大阪。
*Airline tickets* are expensive during summer vacation.
暑假期間機票很貴。
We went to Tokyo *by plane* last summer.
我們去年夏天搭飛機去東京。
I watched two movies *on the plane*.
我在飛機上看了兩部電影。
It takes three hours to get to Tokyo *by plane*.
搭飛機到東京要三個小時。
We were so excited when we *got on the plane*.
我們上飛機時好興奮。
My uncle picked us up *at the airport*.
我叔叔到機場接我們。
We waited for an hour at *airport security*.
我們在機場安檢等了一個小時。
I *set an alarm* for 6:30 every school day.
每個上學日我都把鬧鐘設在六點半。
My *alarm clock* didn't ring this morning.
我的鬧鐘今天早上沒響。
The *fire alarm* went off during math class.
數學課時火災警報器響了。
Grandma showed us her old *photo album*.
奶奶給我們看她的舊相簿。
My favorite singer has a *new album* out.
我最喜歡的歌手出了新專輯。
The twins *look alike*, but they act differently.
那對雙胞胎長得很像，但個性不一樣。
The new library is popular with *students and teachers alike*.
新圖書館很受學生和老師的歡迎。
Animals need water to *stay alive*.
動物需要水才能活下去。
Is the little fish in the tank *still alive*?
魚缸裡的小魚還活著嗎？
It rained *all day* yesterday, so we stayed home.
昨天下了一整天的雨，所以我們待在家。
*All of us* passed the English test!
我們全部都通過了英文考試！
I'm not tired *at all*, so let's keep studying.
我一點也不累，我們繼續讀吧。
Students *are not allowed to* use phones during tests.
考試時學生不准使用手機。
My parents *allow me to* play games on weekends.
我爸媽准許我週末玩遊戲。
He is *almost always* late for school.
他上學幾乎總是遲到。
*Almost every* student has a phone now.
現在幾乎每個學生都有手機。
She doesn't like *being alone* at home.
她不喜歡一個人在家。
My grandpa *lives alone* in Tainan.
我爺爺一個人住在台南。
Please *leave me alone*. I'm studying.
請讓我靜一靜，我在讀書。
We rode our bikes *along the river*.
我們沿著河邊騎腳踏車。
We're going to the night market. Want to *come along*?
我們要去夜市，要一起來嗎？
I *get along with* everyone in my class.
我和班上每個人都處得很好。
Practice by *reading aloud* for ten minutes a day.
每天朗讀十分鐘來練習。
If you know the answer, *say it aloud*.
如果你知道答案，就大聲說出來。
Small kids learn *the English alphabet* through songs.
小朋友透過歌曲學英文字母。
Put these words *in alphabetical order*.
把這些單字依字母順序排列。
I *have already* finished my homework.
我已經寫完作業了。
*It's already* ten o'clock. Go to bed!
已經十點了，快去睡覺！
She is *not only smart but also kind*.
她不但聰明而且善良。
I'm *not altogether* sure about the answer.
我對答案不是完全確定。
Living abroad is *altogether different* from traveling.
住在國外和出國旅行完全不同。
*As always*, Mom made dinner for everyone.
一如往常，媽媽為大家做了晚餐。
I get up *at seven a.m.* on school days.
上學日我早上七點起床。

collocs.zh: 從上午九點到下午五點
ex: The library is open *from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.*
圖書館從上午九點開放到下午五點。
Someone fell down, so we *called an ambulance*.
有人跌倒了，所以我們叫了救護車。
He was taken to the hospital *by ambulance*.
他被救護車送到醫院。
My cousin goes to college *in America*.
我表姊在美國讀大學。
We learn *American English* at our cram school.
我們在補習班學美式英文。
Her drawing was *among the best* in the contest.
她的畫是比賽中最好的幾幅之一。
This game is *popular among* teenagers.
這款遊戲很受青少年歡迎。
We waste *a large amount of* food every day.
我們每天浪費大量的食物。
Add *a small amount of* salt to the soup.
在湯裡加少量的鹽。
*In ancient times*, people wrote on stone.
在古代，人們把字寫在石頭上。
We are studying *ancient history* in social studies.
我們在社會課學古代歷史。
We visited *an ancient city* in Japan last summer.
我們去年夏天參觀了日本的一座古城。
We bought chips, cookies, juice, *and so on*.
我們買了洋芋片、餅乾、果汁等等。
*Both my mom and my dad* are teachers.
我爸爸和媽媽都是老師。
The baby sleeps *like an angel*.
小寶寶睡得像天使一樣。
My big sister is like my *guardian angel*.
我姊姊就像我的守護天使。
He shouted *in anger* and left the room.
他生氣地大喊，然後離開房間。
Take a deep breath to *control your anger*.
深呼吸來控制你的怒氣。
A square has four *right angles*.
正方形有四個直角。
The picture is hanging *at an angle*.
那幅畫掛歪了。
Try to look at the problem *from a different angle*.
試著從不同角度看這個問題。
My mom *was angry with* me for coming home late.
我媽媽因為我晚回家而生我的氣。
Students *were angry about* the extra homework.
學生們對額外的作業很不滿。
Don't *get angry*. It was just a joke.
別生氣，那只是個玩笑。
You can see *wild animals* in the national park.
你可以在國家公園看到野生動物。
Cows, pigs, and chickens are all *farm animals*.
牛、豬和雞都是農場動物。
I *twisted my ankle* during basketball practice.
我在籃球練習時扭到腳踝。
He can't run because of *a broken ankle*.
他腳踝骨折，所以不能跑。
This cookie is great. Can I have *another one*?
這片餅乾好好吃，我可以再拿一片嗎？
Sorry, I'm busy. Can we go *another time*?
抱歉，我很忙。我們可以改天再去嗎？
Good classmates help *one another* before exams.
好同學在考試前會互相幫忙。
Do you know *the answer to* number five?
你知道第五題的答案嗎？
He raised his hand to *answer the question*.
他舉手回答問題。
Can you *answer the phone*? I'm cooking.
你可以接一下電話嗎？我在煮飯。
Be careful! There are *fire ants* in the grass.
小心！草地上有火蟻。
Do you have *any questions* about the homework?
你對作業有任何問題嗎？
You can call me *at any time*.
你隨時都可以打電話給我。
Does *anyone else* want some bubble tea?
還有其他人想喝珍珠奶茶嗎？
Please *don't tell anyone* about the surprise party.
驚喜派對的事請不要告訴任何人。
Is *anyone else* coming to the library with us?
還有其他人要跟我們去圖書館嗎？
*Hardly anyone* came to the meeting because of the rain.
因為下雨，幾乎沒有人來開會。
Do you need *anything else* from the store?
你還需要從店裡買其他東西嗎？
This rain won't stop *anytime soon*.
這場雨短期內不會停。
If you need help, *call me anytime*.
如果需要幫忙，隨時打給我。
"Sorry, I don't have a pen." "*Thanks anyway*."
「抱歉，我沒有筆。」「還是謝謝你。」
The library is full. Is there *anywhere else* to study?
圖書館滿了，還有其他地方可以讀書嗎？
I'm *not going anywhere* this weekend.
我這週末哪裡都不去。
Is there a bakery *anywhere near* here?
這附近有麵包店嗎？
You can pay with your phone *almost anywhere*.
你幾乎在任何地方都能用手機付款。
My family *lives in an apartment* near the MRT.
我家住在捷運附近的公寓。
Our *apartment building* has twelve floors.
我們的公寓大樓有十二層。
Gorillas and chimpanzees are *great apes*.
大猩猩和黑猩猩都是大型人猿。
You should *apologize to* your sister.
你應該向妹妹道歉。
I want to *apologize for* being late this morning.
我想為今天早上遲到道歉。
Our school band *appeared on TV* last night.
我們學校的樂團昨晚上了電視。
The new student *appears to be* very shy.
那位新同學似乎很害羞。
The singer *made an appearance* at the end of the show.
那位歌手在節目最後露面了。
Don't *judge people by their appearance*.
不要以貌取人。
My little brother *has a good appetite*.
我弟弟胃口很好。
I *lost my appetite* when I got sick.
我生病時一點胃口也沒有。
*An apple a day* keeps the doctor away.
一天一蘋果，醫生遠離我。
I'd like a glass of *apple juice*, please.
請給我一杯蘋果汁。
My sister *applied for* a summer job.
我姊姊申請了一份暑期工作。
She wants to *apply to* three universities.
她想申請三所大學。
*Apply sunscreen* before you go to the beach.
去海邊前要擦防曬乳。
We *appreciate your help* with the school fair.
我們很感謝你在園遊會上的幫忙。
Thanks for your help. *I really appreciate it*.
謝謝你的幫忙，我真的很感激。
Our teacher tried *a new approach* to teaching grammar.
我們老師嘗試用新方法教文法。
There is more than one way to *approach a problem*.
處理一個問題的方法不只一種。
Children's Day in Taiwan is *in April*.
台灣的兒童節在四月。
There are many good restaurants *in this area*.
這一帶有很多好餐廳。
My grandparents live in a *rural area*.
我爺爺奶奶住在鄉下。
Can you find *the area of* this square?
你能算出這個正方形的面積嗎？
I sometimes *argue with* my brother about the TV.
我有時會和哥哥為了電視吵架。
My parents never *argue about* money.
我爸媽從來不為錢吵架。
I *had an argument* with my best friend yesterday.
我昨天和最好的朋友吵了一架。
